title: Simplify pending publish safety UI
summary: Simplified the Pending Publish default WebView workflow so the Action Center is the single visible drain entry point, while forensic guard, drain, recovery, repair, confidence, scope, and post-drain evidence panels move behind Advanced. The backend-owned drain guard and PowerShell movement path remain unchanged.
reason: Pending Publish had accumulated too many always-visible safety and evidence panels, making the normal drain workflow feel blocked by redundant ceremony even though the hard safety belongs in backend and PowerShell validation.
behavior_before: The Pending Publish default page showed the Action Center plus separate guard, drain, readiness, risk, checklist, recovery, repair, confidence, scope, post-drain, and history panels, and recovery dry-run results could refresh the detailed guard without directly refreshing the visible Action Center state.
behavior_after: The default page keeps the Action Center, compact pending summary, flagged items, rows, and selected item visible. Detailed safety evidence, recovery, repair, scope, confidence, and post-drain proof remain available through Advanced. Recovery dry-run evidence refreshes the Action Center, and the visible drain button mirrors the guard state.
tests_added: Pinned Pending Publish daily-use versus Advanced panel placement in tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static_pending_publish.py.
Extended the browser-backed Pending Publish drain guard smoke to assert blocked recovery evidence disables the visible Action Center drain button.
